title: Laxmi Shopping Mall
summary: Commercial retail destination designed with open sightlines, natural daylight integration, and durable high-traffic finishes.
clientBrief: Deliver a commercial shopping landmark in Rewari that maximizes retail store frontage, smooth shopper flow, and structural efficiency with low operating overheads.
designResponse: Engineered an open atrium structure prioritizing ambient illumination, durable vitrified surfaces, and clean architectural lines that ensure tenant visibility across all levels.
materials: Heavy-duty commercial vitrified tiles, engineered structural steel, acoustic grid ceilings, and modular commercial electrical runs.

title: Raghuram Jeweller's Showroom
summary: Bespoke luxury retail jewellery showroom balancing discreet high-security requirements with warm hospitality and high-CRI display lighting.
clientBrief: Design an upscale, secure, and intimate boutique showroom for high-value jewellery buyers in Gurugram, creating an inviting consultative environment.
designResponse: Developed a disciplined palette of warm off-whites, brushed brass Vitrines, concealed safe-room access, and glare-free 3000K focused illumination to highlight gemstone fire.
materials: Brushed brass accents, Italian composite surfaces, acoustic fabric wall panels, reinforced security glass, and custom Nishawe consultation seating.

title: Modern Luxury Villa
summary: Complete turnkey villa transformation with open spatial flow, custom architectural millwork, and tailor-made Nishawe furniture.
clientBrief: Re-engineer an existing builder floor into an expansive, light-filled luxury residence with dedicated family living zones, concealed storage, and bespoke furniture built to exact proportions.
designResponse: Reorganized interior partitions to draw natural light across entertaining spaces. Paired warm fluted wood details with neutral micro-cement textures and integrated Nishawe sectional seating.
materials: Engineered oak panelling, sintered stone slabs, custom high-density foam upholstery, concealed magnetic architectural hardware, and premium architectural coatings.
